thread:
Anna: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to add a thin edge-proxy translation layer that rewrites legacy /v1/generate requests into the new /v2/chat/stream shape so older SDKs keep working. Thoughts?

Raj: Can you sketch the actual transformation we need? streaming vs non-streaming semantics differ.

Anna: Minimal transform: wrap `input` into messages: [{role:\"user\",content: input}] and upgrade to streaming frames. If client didn't accept streaming, proxy can buffer and emit final object. Tradeoff: latency and memory.

Sasha: Buffering worries me. For long outputs we could OOM at the edge. We should avoid full-buffering tenants. Options: 1) force stream and send partial frames, 2) keep non-stream path and call non-stream runtime.

Mike: Option 1 risks breaking clients expecting single response body. Option 2 doubles traffic (two code paths). Maybe expose a tenant opt-in flag: \"compat_generate_mode\" = \"stream|buffered|passthrough\".

Raj: Agree on opt-in. Also need telemetry to mark translated requests: add header x-rwi-compat: generate-v1 so we can see perf delta.

Anna: Good call. Also add per-tenant rate limit guard at the edge to avoid accidental amplification when we translate to multiple internal calls.

Sasha: Observability: add tags on spans: compat_transform=true, transform_type=wrap-to-chatstream. Add sampling override for these spans.

Mike: Security: ensure we don't leak client-supplied metadata into system prompts. Strip deprecated headers (X-Old-Session) unless tenant opt-in.

Anna: POC envoy config snippet:

`````
route:
  match: { path_prefix: \"/v1/generate\" }
  action: {
    cluster: edge-compat
    request_headers_to_add: [{name: \"x-rwi-compat\", value: \"generate-v1\"}]
  }
`````

Sasha: Where does the translator live? edge-compat service or inside the gateway? If inside gateway we get perf win but more complexity. If sidecar/service we can iterate faster.

Anna: Leaning sidecar per-region + hot path in gateway to fast-pass for pure proxies. Sidecar can also hold streaming buffer policy.

Raj: Rollout plan: feature flag keyed by tenant id, start with 5 tenants (internal + 4 customers), watch latency and memory for 48h, then 25%, 50%, full.

Mike: Add a \"panic button\" to kill translations per-tenant at the routing layer. Also add automatic rollback if p50 latency increases > 20% or error rate > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: deploy starting: edge-compat sidecar v0.1 -> us-east-1, canary tenants:[redwood-internal]

Anna: I'll write short runbook and add eval prompt set to ensure outputs unchanged for basic prompts. Posting RFC doc soon: https://go/repo/edge-compat-proposal (WIP)

Raj: FYI: model caching: translation to chat means k-v cache keys should include compat marker so warm cache isn't invalidly reused. Add cache key suffix.

Sasha: Also update cost accounting: count tokens on upstream shape, not original, so billing unchanged.

Mike: Sounds good. Next: quick spike to measure added latency per request for small messages. Can volunteer? @Raj you ok to take spike?

Raj: Yup, will do today. Will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

Anna: Thanks all — we'll keep thread for rollout notes. :party_parrot:
